title: [3.1.0.3] Crash due to unavailable Wearable API on Google Pixel 4 XL
body:
- First ever launch of the app attempted today at 11:46 GMT
- Recreates on latest master as well as dev branches, 3.1.0.3 and 3.1.0.3-dev-a
  upper-right corner).
- I cannot obtain the log files as it's a fresh install but attaching the logcat output from my computer below
- Google Pixel 4 XL @ Android 12 build number SQ3A.220705.003.A1
